prompt: Before 2024, among her own record-breaking streaks, in which Olympic event has Katie Ledecky broken the world record the second most times?
answer: The **women’s 1,500-meter freestyle**—Ledecky broke the world record **four times** before 2024, second only to her **five** 800-meter freestyle world records.
